name: lever ab coaster crunch
description: A machine crunch on a curved track that lets you curl your trunk and knees together. Builds the abs under load.
instructions: Sit on the machine, set the seat and grab the handles.
Place your legs on the pads and keep your back against the support.
Exhale and crunch your torso and knees toward each other.
Pause when your abs are fully squeezed.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
